name: Shenhe
quote: My name is Shenhe. I was born fated to bear the curse of calamity, so I am prone to bring harm to the people around me. The adepti urged me to bind my soul with red ropes to keep my homicidal nature at bay.
description: A disciple raised by the adeptus Cloud Retainer in Liyue's mountains, bound with talisman-inscribed red ropes to suppress the calamitous nature she was born with.
